cover.title: 5 niche ways to find the form field european users quit on

inner.title: count your fields
inner.body: baymard counted an average of 11.3 checkout fields in 2024 and says most sites need only 8. every field past eight is one you can't defend.

inner.title: merge the name fields
inner.body: baymard found 89% of benchmarked sites ask for more than one name field. 42% of testers typed their full name into first name anyway.

inner.title: hide address line 2
inner.body: 75% of sites show address line 2 by default. 30% of baymard's testers stopped right there. baymard says to hide it behind a link.

inner.title: accept every postcode
inner.body: the netherlands uses 1011 AB, poland 00-001, portugal 1000-001, ireland D02 X285. a five-digit rule rejects all four, and the error never says which field.

inner.title: compare start to submit
inner.body: ga4 logs form_start and form_submit with the form's id, name and destination. it never records which field people left, so send field names as your own event.
